verdict.rationale: Sierra offers an Agent SDK for writing customer journeys as code within normal development workflows, and can publish agents via CI/CD. That gives a code-driven path for building and deploying agents. However, no public API reference or OpenAPI spec was found, and the UI-centric features have no documented programmatic equivalents: Agent Studio, knowledge editing, Explorer, Insights and Live Assist. Missing for 10: a documented public API or OpenAPI spec, an API equivalent for knowledge management, analytics/Explorer and Insights, an explicit API–UI parity statement, and independent corroboration.
